spans.s: P. (तेमति, तिमित) To make wet or damp, moisten. --

P. (तिम्यति) 
__1 To become wet. 
__2 To become quiet or tranquil, be calm.

a. [तिम्-कर्तरि-क्त] 
__1 Moist, wet, damp. 2 Motionless, steady. 
__2 Calm, tranquil.

__1 The ocean. 
__2 A kind of whale or fish of an enormous size; (अस्ति मत्स्यस्तिमिर्नाम शतयोजनमायतः । ); अमी शिरोभिस्तिमयः सरन्ध्रैरूर्ध्वं वितन्वन्ति जलप्रवाहान् [[

.]] 
__3 A fish in general; गरीयसेऽपकाराय तिमीनां बडिशं यथा [[Śiva

.]] 
__4 The figure of a fish produced by drawing two lines, one intersecting the other at right angles. 
__5 The sign of Pisces (मत्स्य, मीन).
